readings: For each telescope (`telescref`) in the signals table, compute its average modulation index (`modindex`), ignoring missing values. Then list the telescopes whose average is above the overall average, taking the overall average as the mean of the per-telescope averages. For each one, show the telescope reference, its average modulation index, how much it exceeds the overall average, and its average as a ratio to the group average. Return the top 10 by that ratio, highest first, without rounding.
queries:
WITH telescope_averages AS (
    SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals
    GROUP BY telescref
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS group_average
    FROM telescope_averages
)
SELECT
    t.telescref,
    t.avg_modindex,
    t.avg_modindex - o.group_average AS excess_overall_average,
    t.avg_modindex / o.group_average AS ratio_to_group_average
FROM telescope_averages AS t
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE t.avg_modindex > o.group_average
ORDER BY ratio_to_group_average DESC
LIMIT 10
